dataset.note: solo running races only (scripts/race_data/dataset_stats.py): left out 204 bike / triathlon / relay / duo / team / walk / stage / time-limited formats and PTL by name, 3 courses whose median finisher effort speed is a bike's or broken timing, 5 with fewer than 10 finishers, 2 without checkpoint distances. events = event series (an event's editions count once); finishers are those stored (UTMB Live up to 676 per race, the fastest third whole; LiveTrail up to 80)

fit.note: gradient curve + fatigue by hours + night in the app: fitted on UTMB Live races 40-180 km with a GPS track (train events: 71 races, 12464 finishers). Refit on 2026-10-04 on 121 running races with a track (43714 finishers; train events 74 races, 29596 finishers): no gain on the held-out events, not adopted

refit.selected_form: current curve kept, fatigue / night / terrain refitted (2-fold CV by event on train)

transjeju_2026.note: held-out race. mean_abs_gap_min: the plan's time at each checkpoint for bib 10, planned at his own finish (the population model sets the shape; the level comes from the athlete's race model, so it gives no predicted_s)

livetrail.note: extra validation, never used to fit or select: LiveTrail courses 40-180 km without GPS track (profile from section D+/D-), night not scored

validation.note: mean |gap| between the plan and the finishers' times at the checkpoints, each finisher planned at his own finish, on 6 events held out since the first fit (chiangmai, kullamannen, puertovallarta, transjeju, utmb, whistler). before = after = the app (the refit was not adopted: 18.59 vs 18.61, better on 23/47 races, Transjeju guard worse). legacy = the app before the first fit
